description: This file contains the definition of NatsOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for the NATS JetStream stream provider within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes properties for stream naming, client options, partitioning, connection management, and serialization settings.

classes.name: NatsOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for connecting to and managing the NATS JetStream stream provider in Orleans, including stream name, client options, partitioning, connection count, and serialization settings.
